How this site is built, and credit where it's due.

**Stack.** It's a static site generated by [Jekyll](https://jekyllrb.com/) and hosted on [GitHub Pages](https://pages.github.com/), built automatically by GitHub Actions on every push. Notes and posts are plain Markdown. No database, no tracking, no cookies.

**Type.** Headings and long-form prose are set in [Newsreader](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Newsreader); the interface uses [Inter](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Inter). The accent is a deep ink blue.

**Foundation.** The underlying digital-garden machinery — wiki-style `[[links]]`, backlinks, note previews, and search — comes from the open-source [**Jekyll Garden**](https://github.com/Jekyll-Garden/jekyll-garden.github.io) theme (MIT), created by Raghuveer S, Hiran Venugopalan, and Asim K T. I've reworked the design and made it my own, but the good bones are theirs. The dark-mode switcher is adapted from [Derek Kedziora](https://github.com/derekkedziora)'s work.

**Writing.** Everything in the [blog](/posts) and [garden](/notes) is mine, written by me. Where I use AI as a thinking or drafting aid, the ideas and final words are still my responsibility.
